traditions.d: Natural diamonds cleaved from rough and lightly polished, not faceted, set foil-backed in gold.

traditions.p: peak under the Mughals, 16th–17th c.; Rajput courts 17th–18th c.; living
traditions.d: Prong-free setting of uncut and table-cut gems in gold, each stone locked by pressed kundan foil.

traditions.mat: gold, polki, table- and flat-cut diamonds, foiled coloured stones, carved gem panels
traditions.auth: no prongs; visible kundan border round each stone; enamelled reverse; flat-cut or uncut stones, not brilliants; watch for brilliant-cut replacements
